algebraic_mechanism: The SD/ASD completeness tensors are identical: sum_k omega_k+_{ac} omega_k+_{bd} = sum_k omega_k-_{ac} omega_k-_{bd}. This implies sum_k C[a,k]_{ij} C[a,k]_{mn} = sum_k C[k,a]_{ij} C[k,a]_{mn} for all a,i,j,m,n. Since the boundary pairing (Ozuch Prop 2.10) involves exactly this bilinear form through the S^3 quartic moment, the leading inter-node Green response is chirality-independent.
consequence: At leading order in the Ozuch desingularization framework, the mixed-chirality and same-chirality inter-node obstruction coefficients are EQUAL. Any chirality difference must arise at higher order: through nonlinear terms (Q^(3)), the v-parameter coupling, or the H_{4}^4 correction term.
